final: SELECT step3.event_name, step3.avg_amount, step3.difference, step3.avg_amount / step4.overall_avg as ratio FROM (SELECT step1.event_name, step1.avg_amount, step1.avg_amount - step2.overall_avg as difference FROM (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) as avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name) step1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) as avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name)) step2 WHERE step1.avg_amount > step2.overall_avg) step3 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) as avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name)) step4
